penalties_applied.name: regulated_industry
penalties_applied.reason: GDPR/CCPA compliance tooling that makes legal representations about data deletion completeness and audit defensibility is a regulated compliance domain; errors carry legal liability and the output must be defensible to regulators and courts.

rationale: The buyer is highly specific — Salesforce admin or VP Compliance at a B2C company with active GDPR/CCPA obligations — and the pain is severe and concrete: losing audit trail after deletion creates real litigation exposure, as the billing-dispute example illustrates. Compliance software commands premium pricing and buyers are accustomed to paying. However, the regulated_industry penalty is warranted because any tool making representations about legal defensibility of deletion audit trails operates in legal/compliance territory where errors have direct liability consequences; this caps the total below the build threshold. The idea warrants validation to confirm that a Claude-generated anonymized audit log report (not legal advice, just structured output) would satisfy buyer needs without triggering liability concerns.
solution_plan: The micro-service is a 'GDPR/CCPA Deletion Audit Reporter for Salesforce': the customer exports their Salesforce deletion log or pastes structured deletion records into a form, and Claude generates a formatted, timestamped, anonymized audit report (what was deleted, when, who approved, what non-personal transaction metadata was retained) suitable for internal compliance records. BUILD: the factory creates a Claude prompt that accepts structured deletion data and outputs a formatted audit report; a simple intake form (Typeform or a factory-built HTML page) collects the deletion records; Stripe handles one-time or monthly payment ($49-149/month). SELL: target Salesforce admins and compliance managers at B2C SaaS companies via LinkedIn outreach (searchable by Salesforce + GDPR keywords) and the Salesforce AppExchange community — outreach goes out only after operator approval. MAINTAIN: customers submit deletion records via the form, Claude generates the report automatically, the report is emailed back; billing is Stripe recurring; the only recurring human touch is approving outreach batches. IMPORTANT caveat: the service must be explicitly framed as 'structured record-keeping output, not legal advice' to avoid liability — validate this positioning with a single paying customer before building further, and consider having a lawyer review the disclaimer language.
notes: Weighted total (6.8) clears the build threshold and all build_gates are met (operational_autonomy=6 meets the ≥6 floor needed to avoid the hard gate at 7 — wait: operational_autonomy_min is 7 and score is 6, so this FAILS the build gate). Build gate failure: operational_autonomy=6 < required floor of 7. Stage capped at validate. Per-customer report generation is mostly automated but may require human review of edge cases in deletion records. Validate first: confirm buyers accept a Claude-generated report as sufficient for their compliance records, and clarify liability framing before building.
